sources.entry: sentry-skills - Agent skills the Sentry team uses for code review, pull requests, and Django reviews.

summary.one_liner: A collection of Agent Skills and subagents, following the Agent Skills open format, that the Sentry team uses for code review, pull requests, commits, security review, and related engineering tasks.
summary.what_it_does: The repository is a marketplace-style plugin bundle of about 35 skills, each a SKILL.md file under skills/, plus two subagents (code-simplifier and senpai) under agents/. Skills cover code review, Django access-control and performance review, GitHub Actions security review, secret serialization leak detection, commit and branch conventions, PR writing and linking, PR screenshots, iterating on PRs until CI passes, and writing or scanning agent skills. Other skills target writing and brand copy, presentation slides, API endpoint documentation with drf-spectacular, Sentry frontend issue triage, mypy exclusion cleanup, and SRED grant documentation. The README says the skills are for Sentry employees and that they are vendored copies used regularly by the team. Installation is through the Claude Code plugin marketplace or the skills.sh npx command.
use_cases: Run consistent code reviews and security reviews on a Python or Django codebase
Write commit messages and PR titles and descriptions that follow team conventions
Review GitHub Actions workflows for exploitable issues
Iterate on a pull request until CI passes and review comments are addressed
Author and scan new agent skills for a repository
Organize engineering work into SRED tax-credit submissions
stack: Agent Skills open format (SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter)
notable: Skills are scoped to Sentry's internal engineering practices, including Linear, Notion, and Sentry issue workflows
Includes a SPEC.md convention for maintaining each skill's intent, scope, and evaluation expectations
Ships both skills and subagents through one root plugin manifest
Works with multiple agents via the skills.sh ecosystem, including Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, and GitHub Copilot
Vendors selected skills from external sources with attribution comments
caveats: Written for Sentry employees; many skills assume Sentry-internal tools and conventions
Sparse marketplace checkouts must include skills and agents directories or the plugin will not load
Some skills reference internal systems such as the Sentry javascript project queue and Linear tickets
